Delivered · 2026-11-10T19:08Z

PR #32296 merged (`e267b96b`, 2026-11-10T18:12Z). An Entra ID OIDC provider now registers with no `OS_TRUSTED_ORIGINS` (a built-in companion-origin table trusts `https://graph.microsoft.com` for the discovery validation of a `login.microsoftonline.com` issuer only; the CSRF allow-list is unchanged). Claims the userinfo response lacks, the groups claim included, are read from the vendor-verified id_token, and a provider can skip userinfo (`skip_user_info`); groups overage warns once and grants nothing. A mailbox-less user is refused as `email_claim_missing`, naming the claim, and the SSO docs page gives the Entra email mapping (`preferred_username`, or `upn`). The console half is #32297 (`domain:ui`), now unblocked. Waiters: cloud#3666 / cloud#3667. Nothing left on this card; `pm:dispatched` and `pm:blocking` removed.
